commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+3' The attendance is 13186.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
90+2' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
90+2' Roberto Lopez (Leganes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
88' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
85' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Juan Cruz and he is replaced by Enric Franquesa (Leganes).
82' Flag goes up against Valentin Rosier (Leganes) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch so that Jorge de Frutos can be given a rest.
77' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano).
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sebastien Haller as he is replaced by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes).
74' Borja Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) replacing Adria Altimira.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Alvaro Garcia.
66' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Seydouba Cisse will be replaced by Darko Brasanac (Leganes).
64' Here is a change. Sergio Camello is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Substitution. James Rodriguez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
63' Substitution. Pathe Ciss makes way for Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).

61' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Augusto Batalla shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
60' Roberto Lopez (Leganes) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
59' Leganes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play and Leganes manage to earn a corner.
57' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) for a tough tackle.

55' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Juan Cruz (Leganes) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the top right corner. The assist goes to Valentin Rosier and the score changes to 1:1.
52' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
50' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
50' Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
50' James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
49' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic was alert and made an astonishing save!
48' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) has a goal ruled out for offside!
47' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Sebastien Haller (Leganes) heads on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Valentin Rosier (Leganes) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
41' Adria Altimira (Leganes) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
40' Flag up against James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
39' James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
36' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
33' Juan Cruz (Leganes) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
31' A great solo run by Juan Cruz (Leganes) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Augusto Batalla.
30' Leganes fail to score from a corner as Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) leaps to collect the ball.
27' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Renato Tapia (Leganes), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
24' The corner is swung in but Leganes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
22' Handball by Valentin Rosier (Leganes).
21' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
17' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
15' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
11' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
10' The game is interrupted now, Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

8' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 1:0. Marko Dmitrovic was helpless.
4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Javi Hernandez (Leganes) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Leganes will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz will supervise the game today.
